items.name: status-glyph
items.title: Status Glyph
items.description: One Flow Production Tracking status icon, from the site's own image or a cell of the stock sprite.
items.docs: The icon alone, at whatever size the caller draws it. Pass siteUrl for a stock cell the package does not bundle.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: Status Badge
items.description: One Flow Production Tracking status as a coloured badge, using the site's own bg_color and icon.
items.docs: Pass the resolved Status row for colour and icon, or just a field schema for the label. An unknown code renders as itself in a muted badge.

items.name: entity-chip
items.title: Entity Chip
items.description: A linked Flow Production Tracking row as a chip, with a per-type glyph, optional thumbnail and a remove control.
items.docs: Takes an EntityRef exactly as an entity field returns it. With no name it falls back to `Type #id`. A preview list installs EntityCard for the hover card.

items.name: entity-card
items.title: Entity Card
items.description: One Flow Production Tracking row as a card, or as a thumbnail-first tile: thumbnail, name, status and its field values.
items.docs: Reads the row through an SgContext when given a reference, labels every dotted path through the schema, and draws values itself so nothing depends on it in return. The tile variant is what EntityGrid lays out.

items.name: thumbnail
items.title: Thumbnail
items.description: A row's thumbnail, with aspect ratio, an explicit no-image placeholder and a play overlay.
items.docs: The value of an image field is the only state marker there is: null, still transcoding, or ready. All three render.

items.name: user-avatar
items.title: User Avatar
items.description: A person as a round avatar, with an initials fallback, inactive styling and an API-user badge.
items.docs: Initials come from core's initialsOf so both frameworks derive them identically.

items.name: field-value
items.title: Field Value
items.description: Any Flow Production Tracking attribute value, rendered for display by its data type.
items.docs: Installs EntityChip, StatusBadge and Thumbnail alongside it.

items.name: picker-row
items.title: Picker Row
items.description: The row every picker, search and tree draws: a picture, a highlighted label, a sub-label and a typed secondary.
items.docs: The six row-anatomy props of rule 9. It draws a row's contents, not its box: the caller owns the list item.

items.name: state-line
items.title: State Line
items.description: The centred empty and error line every data widget draws, with its glyph and its inset.
items.docs: Rule 5 of docs/design-rules.md, in one place. Loading stays with the widget: skeletons are shaped like the rows they replace.

items.name: picker-classes
items.title: Picker Classes
items.description: The control, popup, list and row classes every picker in this registry wears.
items.docs: Class strings only. Import what a control needs; the ladder and the states are the design rules'.

items.name: entity-type-picker
items.title: Entity Type Picker
items.description: One entity type of a Flow Production Tracking site, or several, as a searchable combobox.
items.docs: Takes a SchemaService. `allow` and `deny` narrow the derived options, so changing them re-filters with no second call.

items.name: field-picker
items.title: Field Picker
items.description: One field of an entity type as a searchable combobox, descending through linked types into a dotted path.
items.docs: Emits ShotGrid's dotted path. Only single entity fields are descended into; a path through a multi-entity field reads back nothing.

items.name: sortable
items.title: Sortable
items.description: Pointer and keyboard reordering for one list, as a hook: drag handles, live-region announcements and transform-only motion.
items.docs: Put the ref on the list element, `data-sortable-id` on each item and `data-sortable-handle` on each grip, then render the announcement in a polite live region.

items.name: column-picker
items.title: Column Picker
items.description: The columns of a grid as a field picker over the ordered list it fills, dragged into place.
items.docs: The picker appends a path to the list; a row is moved by dragging its grip or with Alt and an arrow key. `layout="dual"` gives the two lists side by side.

items.name: text-editor
items.title: Text Editor
items.description: A text field as an input, or a textarea when the field is multi-line.
items.docs: Emits on Enter or on losing focus. An empty input emits null, because a text field has no empty string.

items.name: number-editor
items.title: Number Editor
items.description: The numeric family as one input: number, float, percent, currency, duration and timecode.
items.docs: The data type picks the parse, the format and the step. A duration takes 1h 30m, steps by a quarter of an hour, and shows the minutes it will store.

items.name: checkbox-editor
items.title: Checkbox Editor
items.description: A checkbox field as an editable switch.
items.docs: The type is two-state and never null, so the control has no empty state.

items.name: date-editor
items.title: Date Editor
items.description: A date field as a typed input with a calendar.
items.docs: Takes YYYY-MM-DD and validates the day. A timestamp is never a date on this type.

items.name: date-time-editor
items.title: Date Time Editor
items.description: A date_time field as a date and a time input, shown local and stored UTC.
items.docs: The zone the typed time is read in is named under the control.

items.name: list-select
items.title: List Editor
items.description: A list field as a select over its valid values.
items.docs: With a project id the field's hidden values are subtracted, which REST does not do on write.

items.name: list-multi-select
items.title: List Multi Select
items.description: Several values of a list field, chosen from its valid values with checkboxes.
items.docs: With a project id the field's hidden values are subtracted, which REST does not do on write.

items.name: url-editor
items.title: Url Editor
items.description: A url field as a web link: address and name.
items.docs: Web links only. Uploads mint an Attachment through a separate flow.

items.name: color-editor
items.title: Color Editor
items.description: A color field as a swatch and a text input.
items.docs: Takes r,g,b or a hex code and emits the decimal triple the field stores.

items.name: field-editor
items.title: Field Editor
items.description: One field, displayed or edited: the data type picks the editor and a toggle switches between the two.
items.docs: Installs FieldValue, the eight typed editors and the three pickers alongside it.

items.name: filter-editor
items.title: Filter Editor
items.description: A Flow Production Tracking filter tree edited as rows and nested groups, with the operator menu and the value editor chosen by the field data type.
items.docs: Takes a FilterGroup and emits one on every edit. toApi3Hash turns it into the body _search takes.

items.name: filter-dialog
items.title: Filter Dialog
items.description: The launcher pair from the legacy filter panel: Add filters, Edit filters with a count, and a clear control, opening the editor in a dialog.
items.docs: Edits are staged. Only Apply emits; Cancel drops them and Clear all emits an empty filter.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: Quick facet pills over one entity type, each a segmented pill of field, operator and values writing a condition into a bound filter tree.
items.docs: Pass counts to compute the numbers with a _summarize grouping call; without it the bar tallies one page of rows.

items.name: sort-picker
items.title: Sort Picker
items.description: The ordered sort keys of a query, with add, remove and reorder, emitting the sort string the REST API takes.
items.docs: Emits both the keys and the comma-joined sort string, a leading minus marking a descending key.

items.name: status-picker
items.title: Status Picker
items.description: One Flow Production Tracking status, picked from the codes a project offers.
items.docs: Pass a cached SgClient. The options are valid_values minus the project hidden_values; a code outside them still renders.

items.name: status-multi-picker
items.title: Status Multi Picker
items.description: Several Flow Production Tracking statuses, picked from the codes a project offers.
items.docs: Pass a cached SgClient. Selections outside the option set keep a row of their own rather than being dropped.

items.name: collection-footer
items.title: Collection Footer
items.description: The pager under a collection: page size, range and arrows in pages, the loaded count otherwise.
items.docs: Takes a source and the numbers core's describePaging answers, and drives the source itself.

items.name: entity-table
items.title: Entity Table
items.description: A page of Flow Production Tracking rows as a table: schema-driven columns, server-side sorting, selection, grouping and inline edit.
items.docs: Takes an entity source and resolved columns from @sg-widgets/core. Sorting and grouping go through the server; an edit writes one field and re-reads the row.

items.name: entity-grid
items.title: Entity Grid
items.description: Flow Production Tracking rows as EntityCard tiles, with selection, keyboard navigation and infinite scroll.
items.docs: Takes an entity source and draws every row as an EntityCard tile; the arrows walk the grid and scrolling to the end asks the source for the next page.

items.name: grouped-list
items.title: Grouped List
items.description: Dense Flow Production Tracking rows grouped under collapsible headers with counts.
items.docs: Groups the contiguous runs of the order the server produced, so the source is sorted on the same path.

items.name: entity-tree
items.title: Entity Tree
items.description: A lazy tree over a project's navigation hierarchy, with a keyboard model, tri-state checkboxes and a filter.
items.docs: Expands one level per call through POST /hierarchy/_expand. seedPath opens the tree to a row on mount; checkboxes propagate both ways.

items.name: entity-picker
items.title: Entity Picker
items.description: One Flow Production Tracking entity, chosen by server-side search across one or more types.
items.docs: Server-side search only. Pass a cached client; a query past minQueryLength becomes one contains condition per word.

items.name: entity-multi-picker
items.title: Entity Multi Picker
items.description: Several Flow Production Tracking entities, chosen by server-side search, with checkbox rows and removable chips.
items.docs: Selected rows stay pinned to the end of the option list, so they can be unticked whatever the query.

items.name: user-picker
items.title: User Picker
items.description: People and script accounts, chosen by server-side search across name, login and email.
items.docs: One file exporting UserPicker and UserMultiPicker. Both configure the generic pickers; neither forks them.

items.name: project-picker
items.title: Project Picker
items.description: Projects, chosen by server-side search, with the project thumbnail and its status.
items.docs: One file exporting ProjectPicker and ProjectMultiPicker. Archived projects are left out unless includeArchived is set.

items.name: global-search
items.title: Global Search
items.description: A command palette that searches Flow Production Tracking by name across several entity types.
items.docs: One text search covers every configured type. Results are grouped by type with the matched words in bold; Cmd/Ctrl+K opens it when hotkey is on.

items.name: hierarchical-search
items.title: Hierarchical Search
items.description: A drill-down over the Flow Production Tracking navigation tree, with breadcrumb results.
items.docs: Browses one level per call and searches by matching words, then asking where each hit sits. Emits the row picked and the path that reaches it.

items.name: context-selector
items.title: Context Selector
items.description: The project, row and task a user is working on, changed from recents, assigned tasks or the tree.
items.docs: Installs HierarchicalSearch alongside it. Assigned tasks are one search on Task filtered by task_assignees.
